newsitem.title: FINLAND: HELSINKI STOCKS TAKE A BREATHER, HOLD GAINS.
newsitem.headline: HELSINKI STOCKS TAKE A BREATHER, HOLD GAINS.

text.p: Shares paused for breath after
spurting to new highs on Wednesday, but managed to hold gains
booked amid relief that the U.S. Fed did not tighten monetary
policy. Brokers were calmer on the short-term outlook.
"It looks like Friday will be quite flat," said one, looking
ahead to a holiday on Monday in Britain and the United States.
The HEX index closed down 0.18 percent at 3,092.12 points as
decliners beat advancers 41 to 39. The FOX derivatives and
portfolio index fell 0.25 percent to 1,072.29 points.
Rauma probed new highs in lively trade amid lively
demand in an offering by main owner UPM-Kymmene .
Rauma closed up 0.60 markka at 121.50 after setting a new
122.50 life-high and trade was over 45 million markka. UPM said
the underwriters used their over-allotment option, raising the
offering total to 14.07 million shares.
Pharma group Orion was lively after a newspaper
report that it would investigate a merger with Instrumentarium,
although Orion denied any merger plans, and brokers saw little
gains from a merger.
"The synergy benefits would be very small," one broker said.
Orion rose 3.50 markka to 208.00 and Instrumentarium
added 4.00 markka to 224.00.
Food group Cultor fell 18.00 markka or over six
percent to 277.00 markka -- after it said on Wednesday analysts'
forecasts had not taken into account what the company had said
earlier. This was "a mini profit warning", one broker said.
Shipping group Finnlines set a new 141.00 markka
life-high and closed at 138.00, up 0.50 markka, amid positive
comments. Postipankki said it had a buy recommendation on the
share, based on the company's profit potential.
Finnlines on Wednesday reported Jan-April earnings near the
highest forecast.
